text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Most political parties agree to take part in the forthcoming parliamentary elections.
- Eighteen political groups to merge into one political movement ahead of the elections.
- The government reshuffles local authorities in several Algiers districts.
- President Liamine Zeroual to meet union and social association leaders over elections.
